BiblicalUsage: Shamur is named once, beside Shamir, in the courses of the Levites. The verse carries both names together, of the sons of Michah, Shamur and Shamir, and the two stand side by side in the priestly courses.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name beside Shamir is still a name God kept, and the courses of the Levites had room for both.
